apiTypes.name: RCS Message
apiTypes.description: Send an RCS message using a template configured in RCM. Fill in only the fields your template actually uses — the payload shape is the same for every template.

baseFields.name: to
baseFields.label: Recipient Contact Number
baseFields.helpText: Phone number to send message to (dynamic from Data Extension)

baseFields.name: templateId
baseFields.label: Template ID
baseFields.helpText: Template ID from RCM (dynamic from Data Extension)

messageTextVariables.label: Message Text Variable
messageTextVariables.helpText: Parameter values for template placeholders (0-10 values, optional)

buttonVariables.label: Button Variable
buttonVariables.helpText: Value for suggested-reply/button variables (optional, leave empty to send "[]")

carouselCardTitleVariables.label: Card Title Variable(s)
carouselCardTitleVariables.helpText: Title text for a rich card / carousel card. Add one entry per card if your template has multiple (optional)

carouselCardDescriptionVariables.label: Card Description Variable(s)
carouselCardDescriptionVariables.helpText: Description text for a rich card / carousel card, in the same order as the titles above (optional)

visitWebsiteButtonVariables.label: Visit Website Button Variable
visitWebsiteButtonVariables.helpText: Label for a "Visit Website" suggested-action button (optional)

visitWebsiteUrlVariables.label: Visit Website URL Variable
visitWebsiteUrlVariables.helpText: Target URL for the "Visit Website" suggested-action button (optional)
